scripts.headless:test: sh -c 'rom="$1"; test="$2"; if [ -z "$rom" ] || [ -z "$test" ]; then echo "Usage: npm run headless:test -- <gameromname> <test-file>"; exit 1; fi; node dist/host_headless.debug.js --machine-runtime dist/libbmsx.debug.js --system-rom dist/bmsx-bios.debug.rom --test "$test" "$rom"' --
scripts.ide:test: sh -c 'rom="$1"; test="$2"; if [ -z "$rom" ] || [ -z "$test" ]; then echo "Usage: npm run ide:test -- <gameromname> <ide-test-file>"; exit 1; fi; node dist/host_headless.debug.js --machine-runtime dist/libbmsx.debug.js --system-rom dist/bmsx-bios.debug.rom --ide-test "$test" "$rom"' --
scripts.headless:forcebuildallrun: sh -c 'rom="$1"; if [ -z "$rom" ]; then echo "Usage: npm run headless:forcebuildallrun -- <gameromname>"; exit 1; fi; npm run build:platform:headless -- --debug --force && npm run build:bios -- --debug --force && npx tsx scripts/rompacker/rompacker.ts --mode rompack --skiptypecheck --debug --force -romname "$rom" && npm run headless:game -- "$rom"' --
scripts.headless:forcebuildalltest: sh -c 'rom="$1"; test="$2"; if [ -z "$rom" ] || [ -z "$test" ]; then echo "Usage: npm run headless:forcebuildalltest -- <gameromname> <test-file>"; exit 1; fi; npm run build:platform:headless -- --debug --force && npm run build:bios -- --debug --force && npx tsx scripts/rompacker/rompacker.ts --mode rompack --skiptypecheck --debug --force -romname "$rom" && npm run headless:test -- "$rom" "$test"' --
scripts.libretro-wsl:forcebuildall: sh -c 'rom="$1"; if [ -z "$rom" ]; then echo "Usage: npm run libretro-wsl:forcebuildall -- <gameromname>"; exit 1; fi; npm run build:platform:libretro-wsl -- --force && npm run build:libretro-host-wsl:debug && npm run build:bios -- --force && npm run build:game -- "$rom" --force' --
scripts.build:libretro-host: sh -c 'cmake -S machine/cpp -B build-libretro-host-wsl -G Ninja -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=ccache -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=ccache -DBMSX_BUILD_LIBRETRO_HOST=ON -DBMSX_BUILD_LIBRETRO=OFF -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release && cmake --build build-libretro-host-wsl --config Release --parallel $(nproc) --target bmsx_libretro_host'
scripts.build:libretro-host:debug: sh -c 'cmake -S machine/cpp -B build-libretro-host-wsl -G Ninja -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=ccache -DCMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_LAUNCHER=ccache -DBMSX_BUILD_LIBRETRO_HOST=ON -DBMSX_BUILD_LIBRETRO=OFF -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug && cmake --build build-libretro-host-wsl --config Debug --parallel $(nproc) --target bmsx_libretro_host'
